mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate during monetary easing cycles compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional trigger conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% and the Fed is in an easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.2pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer demand (RSAFS) rises while industrial production (INDPRO) falls, it signals a demand shock with weak supply response, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases and INDPRO decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market booms characterized by rising new home construction (HOUST), consumer spending confidence increases, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous Federal Funds rate cuts and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a coordinated policy response to economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and UNRATE increases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial expansion regimes marked by rising industrial production (INDPRO), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.
